ui.license.title: Software License
ui.license.steps: To activate or renew: 1. Download the license request file  2. Send it to the vendor  3. Import the license file provided by the vendor. No internet connection is required.
ui.license.deactivate_hint: After deactivation, this computer stops analyzing immediately and a deactivation proof file is downloaded. Send the proof together with the new computer's request file to the vendor to complete the transfer. This action cannot be undone.

ui.update.title: Software Update
ui.update.unsupported: Running in development mode; updates and rollbacks are not supported.
ui.update.apply_hint: The service pauses during the update (a few minutes); please let running analyses finish first. A snapshot is taken first, and the system automatically reverts if the new version fails its self-test.
ui.update.rollback_hint: Rolling back restores the data snapshot taken before the update. Records created after the update are saved to an archive file and will not appear in the rolled-back version; they can be imported again after a future update.
ui.update.archives_hint: Records saved during rollbacks; they can be imported after upgrading to a compatible version.

ui.modval.title: Inspection Modules
ui.modval.hint: An inspection module version must be validated and approved before it can produce formal Pass/Fail judgments; judgments from unvalidated modules are limited to Review Required. Approval applies to the major.minor version; patch releases keep the approval.
ui.modval.approve_hint: Confirm that detection rate, false call rate, imaging-condition invariance and repeatability have been validated according to the validation procedure. After approval, recipes using this module can produce formal judgments.
ui.modval.revoke_hint: After revocation, judgments from this module are limited to Review Required. Existing records are not affected.
ui.modval.note_hint: For example: validation image set, summary of validation results
error.validation_note_required: Remarks are required when approving validation
modval.baseline: Initial approval: regression image set and repeat-shot repeatability validation
ui.region.title: Inspection Regions
ui.region.hint: Define include and exclude regions: inspection modules process only targets whose centers lie inside an include region and outside all exclude regions. Without include regions, the whole image is inspected. Coordinates refer to the reference image and are scaled proportionally for images of a different size; redraw the regions if sample placement varies significantly.
ui.region.pick_reference: Select an image from the inspection records
ui.region.rect_hint: Drag on the image to draw a rectangle.
ui.region.polygon_hint: Click to add vertices; double-click to finish.
ui.region.size_mismatch: The selected image differs in size from the original reference image. Existing regions keep the original reference size; please verify their positions.
note.regions_scaled: The image size differs from the recipe's reference image; inspection regions were scaled proportionally. Please verify their positions.
ui.inference.title: Deep Learning Inference
ui.inference.hint: Inspections that use deep learning models (for example the Model or Both method of Void Inspection) run on the inference runtime. GPU use is off by default because the X-ray inspection system may use the GPU for 3D reconstruction; confirm that equipment operation is not affected before enabling it. When disabled or unavailable, inference runs on the CPU.
ui.model.title: Deep Learning Models
ui.model.hint: Model files (.xrvmodel) are trained and signed by the vendor; the signature and contents are verified on import. Recipes reference a model as model_id@version. Retired models cannot be used in newly released recipes; released recipes continue to run.

ui.annot.title: Void Annotation
ui.annot.export_hint: Only annotated images are exported: a crop per ball (16-bit normalized absorption), a void mask and dataset.json, for the vendor to train or validate models.
ui.annot.hint: Correct the void outlines; they serve as ground truth for model training and module validation. A ball without void outlines is confirmed void-free. Annotations are recorded separately from manual reviews and do not change the inspection judgment.
ui.annot.help.polygon: Click to add outline points; double-click or press Enter to finish, Esc to cancel. Scroll to zoom; drag with Shift or the middle button to pan.
ui.annot.help.select: Click an outline and press Delete to remove it. Drag to pan; scroll to zoom.
ui.annot.help.erase: Click a ball to remove all void outlines inside it (confirm void-free).
